Audience size, show-level Spotify URLs and booking routes for top feeders were NOT verified: no searches remained. These are marked 'unverified' and none were guessed. Counts with 'date unverified' entries are approximate. Direct page fetches were not used.

patterns: Three routes show up. (1) Comedians come through the Austin/LA comedy podcast circuit: Kill Tony, Are You Garbage?, Whiskey Ginger/Bad Friends, TigerBelly and Matt & Shane. Several of those hosts (Santino, Bobby Lee, McCusker, Distefano, Duncan Trussell) are Theo guests themselves. (2) Experts, whistleblowers and authors build momentum on big long-form shows (JRE, PBD, Tucker, Breaking Points, Modern Wisdom, Rich Roll, Tim Ferriss), usually 1-8 months before Theo. (3) A big share of 'characters' (Hannah Strickland, Jshock, Young Amish Male, Keith Peterson, RayAsianBoy, The Rizzler) had no podcast trail at all. They were booked straight off viral TikTok/YouTube clips, so a viral short-form clip is itself a feeder.
avery_path: Avery's best entry is the business and lifestyle lane, not comedy. Start with PBD Podcast and Full Send, where luxury, Miami deal-making and celebrity stories land naturally. In parallel, pitch Modern Wisdom or a Matthew Cox-style long-form interview around art-market secrets (forgery, status, art as an asset). Cut the strongest stories, such as the Alec Monopoly origin, wild celebrity collector tales and selling seven figures online, into short vertical clips, because Theo's team clearly books off viral clips. Once there are 2-3 sizable long-form episodes and a clip with traction, use a comedy-adjacent bridge (Whiskey Ginger/Bad Friends, whose hosts are Theo regulars) or direct outreach to Theo's team. Pitch Avery as a colorful Miami art-world character with real-money stories, not as a CEO.
